summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Henley wins Charles Schwab
items.text: Russell Henley won the 2026 Charles Schwab Challenge on Sunday for his sixth PGA Tour victory.

items.headline: LSU’s historic NCAA rally
items.text: LSU overcame a 17-shot deficit with an 18-under 270 round to make the NCAA Championship 54-hole cut and sit three shots behind eighth place.
